text: Chapter 9: Recapturing Eldenbaum@The Battle to Recapture Eldenbaum
Go to Ruins of Urban Elban to find the entrance to\nthe inner part of Eldenbaum while Garrador and the\nElf warriors distract Coenubias!

Exterminate all the Coenubia monsters that are
searching for something in Elban Palace Ruins!

[ff7f00]You can enter the battle to reclaim Eldenbaum from Dikkit
Sector if you withdraw, but you will have to start over![ffffff]

Balsette was the incarnation of Oritius, the God of War!
Together with the awakened Oritius, exterminate the
Coenubia monsters right away!

[ff7f00]You can enter the battle to reclaim Eldenbaum from Dikkit
Sector if you withdraw, but you will have to start over![ffffff]

A magical power is sealing the entrance to the inner part of
Eldenbaum in Ruins of Magic Research Institute. Protect Yarn
and Mondan from the monsters while they are unsealing it!

[ff7f00]You can enter the battle to reclaim Eldenbaum from Dikkit
Sector if you withdraw, but you will have to start over![ffffff]

Thanks to Yarn, Mondan and York, you are able to get to the
inner part of Eldenbaum. The deeper you go, the more
monsters there are. Beat them and keep going!

[ff7f00]You can enter the battle to reclaim Eldenbaum from Dikkit
Sector if you withdraw, but you will have to start over![ffffff]

The Brutal Dragon Decel you set free from Coenubia in the
past came rushing to help. Fight and defeat the monsters
that attack in large numbers together!

[ff7f00]You can enter the battle to reclaim Eldenbaum from Dikkit
Sector if you withdraw, but you will have to start over![ffffff]

You finally made it to the headquarters of the Coenubias
occupying Eldenbaum! Proceed extra carefully and prepare for
the final battle!

You can enter Neo Plastida via Ruins of Urban Elban.

Venena Metacoenubia's attacks were ferocious and when you
were in a jam, Dunkelis and her generals came to help.
Join forces with them and win the final battle!

You can enter Neo Plastida via Ruins of Urban Elban.
